evals.prompt: 我有一篇BERT的论文PDF，帮我做一个beamer的PPT用于组会汇报，大概20分钟
evals.expected_output: A compilable LaTeX Beamer presentation with ~18-20 slides covering BERT's architecture (masked language model, next sentence prediction), pre-training/fine-tuning framework, and experimental results. Should use the Crimson template with Chinese section titles and English technical terms.
expectations: Output contains a main.tex file with \documentclass{beamer}
Uses xeCJK and STKaiti font setup
Does NOT include pstricks or explicit hyperref
Contains at least one \begin{equation} or equation* environment

evals.prompt: I need to present the ResNet paper (Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition) at a reading group next week. Can you make LaTeX slides for a 30-minute talk? I want it in English.
evals.expected_output: A Beamer presentation with ~25-27 slides covering ResNet's residual learning framework, skip connections, degradation problem, and ImageNet results. All content in English since user requested it.
expectations: Output contains a main.tex file with \documentclass{beamer}
Content is primarily in English (not Chinese section titles)
Includes figures placeholders for residual block diagrams
Contains a table comparing model performance

evals.prompt: 帮我把这篇GAN的论文做成beamer幻灯片，15分钟的简短汇报就行
evals.expected_output: A concise Beamer presentation with ~15 slides covering GAN's adversarial training framework, generator/discriminator architecture, minimax game formulation, and training results. Short and focused.
expectations: Output contains a main.tex file with \documentclass{beamer}
Includes ref.bib with at least the GAN paper citation
